combos.why: Patterns that suit it: large solid stripes or panel graphics: break up the confetti; thin white or black pinstripes: sharp lines against the pixel noise
Patterns to avoid: other noise, glitter or camo patterns: stack noise on noise
Spec overlays that work: gloss clearcoat wash: wet shine over the dull base; broad satin gradient spec: sheen across the glitch field
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.

examples.title: Ask for it by name
examples.goal: See Ns Dead Channel on the car.

settings.AI copilot (✦ AI button): put Ns Dead Channel on the hood
